headlines.headline: Florida opens No. 1 in AP preseason poll for first time since 2006-07
headlines.detail: Gators got 47 of 59 first-place votes; Duke No. 2, Illinois and UConn round out the top four. Michigan fell to No. 16 after Dusty May's departure.

headlines.headline: NBA tips off 2026-27 season as Knicks raise championship banner
headlines.detail: New York hosted Philadelphia for the banner ceremony; Boston played at Detroit and Oklahoma City at San Antonio. Tonight: Timberwolves at Heat, Warriors at Lakers.

headlines.headline: Buccaneers' Vita Vea trade request still unresolved as deadline nears
headlines.detail: Two-time Pro Bowl DT requested a trade after stalled extension talks; Rams remain the reported frontrunner with the Nov. 4 deadline approaching.

headlines.headline: Miami and BYU are last undefeated teams atop the poll as Texas, Oregon fall
headlines.detail: Six FBS teams remain unbeaten entering Week 8 after Texas lost to Oklahoma and Oregon fell to UCLA. Defending champ Indiana hosts No. 5 Ohio State next.
